description: Table-driven cases of the judge of loosening, written from the Definitions of CONTRACT_0_3.md. The app's tests and the checker run the same file. The old and new documents of a diff case are first brought to their canonical form (every default written, as the importer does before it compares). A diff case lists the units that differ between two versions of one item and whether each loosens; a due case lists the locks that apply and the instant a loosening requested at "at" may land (null when the change windows share no minute).
unitNames: a field is its dotted path; a rule is rules#<id>; an element of a list is <path>#<element>; the lock is lock and lock.partnerKeyHash; a routine window is due.window
